title: 2026 Week 6 all units: passing 45/45/10 and equal six-metric rushing offense/defense
method: PO/PD: 45% passing PPA + 45% passing success + 10% passing explosiveness, invert allowed defensive metrics. RO/RD: six equal 1/6 metric groups: rush success, rush PPA, line yards, stuff rate, second-level/open-field combined, rush explosiveness; invert allowed defensive metric percentiles. All include same aggressive SEC-first conference adjustments and opposing matched-unit top30 premium. Offense=(PO+RO)/2; Defense=(PD+RD)/2; overall score is previous sensitivity update, not a ground-up recomputation.
limitations: Defensive unit metrics not reconstructed or independently recalibrated; only conference delta applied.
PO and RO research percentages and PD/RD older scale may not be directly comparable; provisional composite until unit scales validated.
Defensive passing metrics use lower-is-better allowed values; no custom override for any team.
PD percentile plus prior scale RD is provisional and has not been calibrated for direct scale parity.
Opponent-quality bonuses reward facing a top-30 unit rather than measuring game-specific outperformance.
Defensive rush percentile normalized independently; interunit rating scale parity remains unvalidated.
Stuff avoidance is a negative rush stuff rate in the source; lower offensive stuff avoidance denotes stronger defensive stuff production.
